# Danilo Stoletović

> Full-Stack Developer • Multiplatform & Systems Builder. Canonical identity: https://danilostoletovic.com/

Danilo builds Android, Windows, web, and edge systems, with 3+ years taking software from architecture to release. Open to freelance software development, engineering advisory, and technical collaborations.

Technologies: Kotlin / Jetpack Compose, Flutter / Dart, WinUI / C#, HTML / CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, Linux / systemd, Raspberry Pi, Docker, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare, and Vercel. Delivery includes Google Play and Microsoft Store publishing.

## Portfolio
- [Homepage](https://danilostoletovic.com/): Projects (#work), biography and technologies (#about), and contact (#contact).
- [Full portfolio in Markdown](https://danilostoletovic.com/index.md): Detailed public project descriptions, services, biography, and contact links; also served on the homepage when Accept prefers text/markdown.

## Projects and source
- [YOLO Smart Vehicle](https://yoloprojekat.com): Raspberry Pi 5 vision, motor control, video and telemetry with an Android client.
- [YOLO Android source](https://github.com/yoloprojekat/android-client): Kotlin / Jetpack Compose client.
- [Class Timetable](https://github.com/danilostoletovic/class-timetable): Open-source Flutter / Dart scheduling app for students and educators.
- [PromptUI](https://github.com/danilostoletovic/PromptUI): TypeScript AI interface experiment, in beta.
- [Portfolio source](https://github.com/danilostoletovic/portfolio): HTML, CSS, and a small optional JavaScript Secretary interface.
